meta.deterministic: eval mode, softmax over logits, no sampling
meta.premise: context_docs actually shown (not re-retrieved); Condition A excluded
meta.hypothesis: model answer (full) plus main claim sentence (longest) if multi-sentence
meta.aggregation: max entailment across shown chunks and across full/main-sentence; max contradiction recorded
meta.definitions_note: NLI entailment and the judge's 'grounded' are related but NOT identical definitions. This is convergent evidence that answers are context-driven, not a strict equivalence test.

nli_vs_judge_grounding.note: Marginals are near-degenerate (24 of 25 cells share one judge class), so kappa is expected to be uninformative; the convergent signal is the OBSERVED AGREEMENT rate, not kappa.
